answer: Clone farms amplify rewards by forking one mind across a delta of fake addresses. Mechanism: each join must deposit a pearl of 2.8 POA into lantern escrow; the pearl only matures after four sequential work epochs where net useful attestations stay above 60% of capacity. Cost is locked pearl capital plus 0.2 POA per failed epoch. Peers verify capacity tallies against on-ledger seals. Failure: dipping below 60% twice slashes 33% of the pearl and resets the maturity clock.
